title: ever JORDANE|Spaghetti Strap Cold Shoulder Chiffon A-Line Midi Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
This elegant bridesmaid dress combines chic design with a flattering fit. Featuring spaghetti straps and cold-shoulder detailing, it adds a modern twist to a timeless A-line silhouette. Crafted from lightweight chiffon, it flows beautifully, offering comfort and style for your special day. Perfect for summer weddings and formal events.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi Length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
